onFail.instruction: Confirm the previous call failed before retrying. If completion is uncertain, inspect its status first to avoid duplicate generation. Retry only within the feedback-round budget; do not automatically retry quota, policy or permission refusals.

stopWhen: Stop after two feedback rounds, when the same failure recurs after correction, when capability is blocked, or when essential inputs must change. Return mismatch for an unacceptable produced direction, blocked for an execution failure, or waiting for missing input. Never return done with failed or unchecked criteria. A retry is not proof of acceptance.
